title: Experience Spyglass, Now Live!
summary: Experience enhanced visibility and insights as Spyglass, our powerful new tool, officially launches for all users!

title: Empowered File Management
summary: Take full command of your content with new, intuitive tools that allow you to easily upload, remove, download, and customize the display of all embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We are thrilled to launch our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into recently shipped features, upcoming releases, and future plans.

title: Smarter Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes for effortless task management, making them easier to click, drag, and seamlessly consistent with our sleek design.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded the editor's collaboration experience, ensuring teams can work together more seamlessly and intuitively.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Users can now effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, making teamwork smoother and more integrated.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: We are thrilled to introduce robust support for numerous international languages, enabling a truly global experience for all Noeko users.

title: Noeko's Open Source Release
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Intuitive Knowledge Explorer
summary: We're making your knowledge base more interactive and discoverable than ever, allowing you to filter by tags and time, see shared content, and effortlessly navigate your insights to kickstart new ideas.

title: Dynamic Search & Custom Collections
summary: Unlock precise control over your information by filtering and sorting your knowledge base, then save these tailored views as custom collections for instant recall.

title: Personalized Note Display
summary: Tailor your note-taking experience with dynamic display modes for connected content, making your workspace reflect your unique thought process.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Paid Plans
summary: Prepare to unlock the full potential of Noeko with new self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans designed to give you more control and advanced functionality.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Favorites
summary: Prepare for a vibrant visual upgrade as we enhance existing themes and introduce a collection of captivating new styles for your ultimate personalization.

title: Enhanced Greetings for a Perfect Welcome
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greeting always accurately reflects the time of day, providing a more personalized and timely welcome every time you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your content by quickly removing tags from multiple items directly within the tag view, saving you valuable time.

title: Seamlessly Integrate More Content Types
summary: Effortlessly centralize all your valuable knowledge by seamlessly integrating new content types like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, expanding how you capture and organize information.
